column1: # Slack thread event templates, one line per kind: kind<TAB>template.
# Read from $CP_HOME/templates/thread-events.tsv by bin/cmdp relay. Built-in
# defaults (internal/cmdp/relay.go) apply for any kind this file omits.
# Any other {{...}} is a fail-closed render error.
# What may appear here is bounded by isolation, not by taste:
#   - This job's own fields only. A template can name nothing outside the
#   - {{blocked_on}} is already redacted: a cross-origin br dep blocker renders
#     as "another job", never its id or plain-language label.
#   - No fleet-wide text. The STATUS BLOCK is terminal-only (AGENTS.md).

column2: Job {{br_id}} reported back — {{title}}. Review is with the operator.
